== Summary ==
Identified: [[Quirin Fürgut]] (centre, beard, dark skull/Red Fang tee; same face as [[:File:Quirin Fürgut 2023 European Championship.jpg]] and [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 14.jpg]]) and [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (right, black tee, short brown hair; same face as [[:File:Cedrik Vanderhaegen 2023 European Championship.jpg]] and [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 19.jpg]]). The man with glasses in a dark jacket is not named.

Quiz tie-breaker question on the screens during the "Not So Fun SWCCG Quiz", 2023 Naboo Regionals weekend, Liverpool, UK, June 2023.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-06-05
* '''Identification:''' [[Quirin Fürgut]] (centre, beard, dark skull/Red Fang tee; same face as [[:File:Quirin Fürgut 2023 European Championship.jpg]] and [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 14.jpg]]) and [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (right, black tee, short brown hair; same face as [[:File:Cedrik Vanderhaegen 2023 European Championship.jpg]] and [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 19.jpg]]). The man with glasses in a dark jacket is not named.
